title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Party With Everyone〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I wanna use these assets I just sent you for the video, Enanan, but I'm worried that their designs or colors are gonna clash with your illustrations. What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<The designs seem fine.
But things might get iffy if we go any more saturated on the colors.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I figured I was right on the line with the colors... Got it, thanks!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I made some changes to the lyrics.
I'll send them over to you two now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You made changes? Has K looked at them?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No, I just adjusted a few things that caught my attention.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, in that case, I'll take a look at them later.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How do you think K's doing with her song? Based on her usual pace, she should have a rough draft done soon.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She is trying to accomplish something pretty hard this time around, so it's probably gonna take her a while longer.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, that reminds me...
We still haven't thrown an after-party for the song we uploaded the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, you're right...
We uploaded it, had everyone in SEKAI listen to it, and then just sorta got to work on the next one.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But we'd probably just be getting in K's way if we asked her about throwing one now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She said that she wanted to focus, and has been staying off of Nightcord entirely.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, I guess we have to wait until she's done making a demo and things have settled down a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, Yuki, what was that sound just now?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah... Do you think it was inside the house? Or outside?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, but I have to stop working. I'm hanging up now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, don't just leave! Tell us what's going on!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (To think Kanade's been working nonstop without eating or sleeping much...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And this isn't even the first time she's done this, it sounds like. She keeps pushing herself way too hard...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's been a whole day since then. I hope she's okay.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mafuyu and Rin have been keeping an eye on her, so she probably is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Maybe Mafuyu's still awake.
I'll try poking her in chat.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thanks for keeping an eye on her.
I feel a lot better now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...
<Don't you have to go to school today? Do you think you'll be able to make it?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Yes. Rin and the others will take my place while I'm gone.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <In that case, can you tell Rin and the others to let me know if anything happens? I'll be home all day!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Rin got so mad at Kanade for overdoing it, so I'm sure she'll keep a close watch.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh...! Hey, Yuki!
Are you done with your homework?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. Is Enanan still taking a bath?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Seems like it. Oh, that reminds me.
Is K really gonna get back to work starting tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She is feeling better now, so I see no reason to stop her...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But we have been telling her to not push herself so hard.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It must've been really hard to nurse her back to health and make food for her and stuff, all while still going to school every day.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I mean, I didn't do much aside from make her food. And she spent most of the time resting, so it wasn't that bad.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, Yuki, now that K's healthy, it'd be a bummer if something were to happen to you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, even if you don't feel that tired, but make sure you rest properly too, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, we'll throw ourselves a really fun after-party!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Right...
In that case, maybe I'll wrap up early today...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Great! That's just what I wanted to hear!>
